profile.headline: Full Stack Developer | Expertise in C#,.Net, Angular,
profile.summary:
•	14+ years of professional experience working as a Software Developer.
•	Excellent experience in multi-tier Web-based applications in all phases of software analysis, design, development and deploying N-tier web applications, client/server applications using AngularJS, Angular2/4/7/8, .Net Core, ASP.NET4.5/5, MVC4/5, C#, WCF, Web Services,
•	Experienced in developing a Single Page Application (SPA) by using Angular 8.
•	Experienced in responsive Ul design and tools such as HTML4/5, CSS3, Bootstrap, AJAX, and AngularJS.
•	Developed software using MVC and Code first entity framework.
•	Used Entity Framework, Data Sets, Data Readers for retrieving, querying, and storage.
•	Capable to work high visible projects by meeting the schedules and following the quality processes to ensure the quality of the deliverables.
•	Used jQuery extensively across the application like making Ajax calls, cascading menus, calendar controls, tooltips, sliding menus, Ajax loading tabs, and expand collapse panels.
•	Expertise in implementation of optimized secured WCF Services by using Service, Operation, Data, Fault and Message Contracts.
•	Expertise in creating web pages in ASP.NET using C#.NET with AJAX.
•	Experience using Source Code Version Control Systems like TFS (Team- Foundation Server) and GlT.
•	Proven ability to work in both independent and team environment and having the ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure.
•	Self-motivation, verbal and written communication skills and commitment to quality brings a lot of professionalism to my work environment and makes me highly adaptable to everyday changes.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Direct mortgage lender. Marketing technology team owning the main NAF website and affiliated marketing sites.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
LA Fitness is an American gym chain with more than 700 clubs across the United States and Canada. I am part of SharePoint team at La fitness, where we work on intranet part of the la fitness portal. I worked on multiple projects at la fitness which includes payroll inquiry, custom facility calendar which they use to schedule the maintenance appointment. I also work on VP order form from where fitness VP can order the items that are missing per club.
•	Designed a Web application using Web API with AngularJS, leveraged Entity Framework (EF).
•	Implemented ng-repeat to display tabular data and utilized CRUD features such as sorting, filtering, paging, and data manipulation and by using AngularJS.
•	Used CSS3 and HTML5 to design a fully responsive user interface and utilized Bootstrap.
•	Utilized built-in directives such as ng-show, ng-hide, ng-if, ng-include, ng-repeat, ng-model, etc.
•	Created Angular service and integration with RESTful APIs.
•	 Used Angular $http to send GET/POST request to fetch data from the server.
•	 Implement the DAL layer of Web API using Entity Framework 5.
•	 Created custom directives for reusable components used across the application.
•	Implemented validation method for form input in the web page using a combination of normal HTML validator (use "novalidate", to bypass the normal HTML checking and handle them using ng-show, ng-hide, ng-disable) and specific AngularJS validator directive (ngRequired).
•	Used Team Foundation Server (TFS) for source code management.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Fitness chain with 700+ clubs in the U.S. and Canada; built intranet portal applications for club and corporate staff.

positions.title: .Net Developer
positions.description:
In Dot Printer I Developed e-commerce solution to create, maintain and operate multiple stores from a single installation of the SQL database and code base. Created additional features to e-commerce solution for administrator approval of orders, packages for reselling the system with different features and the plug-in system for third party developers.
•Designed Web Forms using different ASP.NET Server Controls, Validation Controls, and other third party controls.
•Created WCF API for e-commerce solution to service internal and third party clients.
• Wrote SQL Queries, Stored procedures, Joins, Triggers to process the large collection of products and used Data Reader, Data Adapter, SQL Command and Dataset for retrieving data from database using SQL Server 2008/2012.
•XML Web Services are exposed to provide the Project details to Vendor applications. 
•Responsible for developing WCF Services using C#. The application extensively absorbs and exposes web services. 
•Created reusable Partial Views and used them in the user interface along with a third-party Graphical Menu controls.
•Responsible for developing Layout, Nested Layout Pages, Partial Views Using CSS style sheets for having the common layout and look and feel to all the controls.
•Responsible for using Jquery for Client Side Validations, Calling the Controller Actions, and Making calls to the WCF Services.
•Developed Ajax calls through Jquery in MVC structure.
•Used code first entity framework for database design.
•Created intranet website with MVC, entity framework, razor and kendo-ui to access, analyze and update data. 
•I developed software (console, Win Forms, Windows Workflow and asp.net MVC) and database (SQL) for the medical client that resulted in daily imports of data.
•Coordinated with the QA team and make sure all the functionality of the application are tested.
•Responsible for maintaining versions of source code using Team Foundation Server (TFS).

positions.title: Web developer
positions.description:
As a WebDeveloper extensively worked on HTML/CSS, Jquery, Asp.net,PHP and Classic ASP and also worked on COBALT (COBALT is in-house ERP software for E-Commerce Websites).In blueswitch I mainly worked on  developing ecommerce solutions. I developed Google API for store locator.I also worked on 3rd party grid and report components such as devExpress,Telerik.

•	Developed master pages and themes for different websites
•	Involved in designing and coding of Content manager for each sites
•	Used Data Grid, Data List and Repeater for various pages
•	Designed and developed Search feature on the website for product search
•	Used JQuery plug-in for better animation 
•	Used .NET validation controls on several pages
•	Designed and Implemented custom error page to provide security and sends email notification containing error message and IP address
•	Designed and developed  picture manager and Press, LookBook, Hotspot pages.
•	Used Google API for Store locator
•	Product manager for products on websites
•	Produce HTML/CSS templates from PSD
•	Adding new features to the main website and improve user experience
•	Maintain existing scripts and web pages
•	Extensively used JQuery and JavaScript for website development
•	Working knowledge of 3rd party grid and report components such as DevExpress, Telerik.
•	Worked on Classic ASP for website maintenance
•	Developed Email Manager and text manager system with the Classic ASP platform
•	Involved in the discussions with the designer team, client and manager to design the website.
•	Created login page based on different users’ roles
•	Designed and created the database based on the requirements of the website
•	Developed the user interface using HTML and CSS
•	Created many web methods according to the client requirement.
•	Designed and developed reusable code structure for E-commerce websites.
